capabilities: convert the active note to a standalone .html file
batch-convert all Markdown files in a folder
embed local images as base64 data URIs
render Mermaid diagrams to inline SVG
apply dark, light, or theme-matched output styling
extras: The manifest description mentions rendering spatial HTML (compare, timeline, slides) with zoom controls, but the README only documents one-way conversion to standalone HTML files. Requires Obsidian 1.7.0+; installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian notes are locked inside the app, and sharing a formatted note as a web page normally requires manual conversion.
summary: Export plugin that converts Markdown notes into standalone HTML files with inline CSS, embedded images, and SVG Mermaid diagrams.
